FULL_MANIFESTATION.title: Full Manifestation
FULL_MANIFESTATION.description:
[gold]Rika[/gold] enters [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold] for 5 turns.
If she has stored [gold]Techniques[/gold], choose 1 to add to your [gold]hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
CURSED_ENERGY_REINFORCEMENT.title: Cursed Energy Reinforcement
CURSED_ENERGY_REINFORCEMENT.description:
Gain X [gold]Strength[/gold]. Gain X [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
Gain X Energy.|}
KNOCK_IT_DOWN.title: Knock It Down!
REVERSE_CURSED_TECHNIQUE.title: Reverse Cursed Technique
IMITATION.title: Imitation
IMITATION.description:
[gold]Rika[/gold] deals {RikaDamage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], after combat gain a [gold]Technique[/gold] reward: choose 1 of 3 cards from other characters to store in the [gold]Promise Ring[/gold]. Rare cards in Elite and Boss fights.
BIND.title: Bind
BIND.description: Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold] lasts {FullManifestationPower:diff()} more turns.
WHICH_ONE_YUTA.title: Yuta, Which One?
WHICH_ONE_YUTA.description:
During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], at the start of each turn choose 1 of 3 {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]upgraded[/gold] |}cards to add to your [gold]hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
Rika's stored [gold]Techniques[/gold] are offered first; cards from other characters fill the rest.
RIKA_CLAW.title: Rika's Claw
CURSED_BLADE.title: Cursed Blade
CURSED_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], attack twice instead.
QUICK_DRAW.title: Quick Draw
RIKA_GUARD.title: Rika's Guard
RIKA_GUARD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If [gold]Rika[/gold] is present, gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} more [gold]Block[/gold].
RIKAS_CURSED_ENERGY.title: Rika's Cursed Energy
RIKAS_CURSED_ENERGY.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], gain 1 additional Energy.
CURSED_SPEECH_DONT_MOVE.title: Cursed Speech: Don't Move
CURSED_SPEECH_DONT_MOVE.description:
Can only be played during [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold].
[gold]Stun[/gold] an enemy. Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
AUTONOMOUS_GUARD.title: Autonomous Guard
AUTONOMOUS_GUARD.description: At the start of each turn, if [gold]Rika[/gold] is present, she deals {AutonomousGuardPower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
DEVOUR.title: Rika, Eat It
DEVOUR.description: [gold]Rika[/gold] devours a [gold]Technique[/gold]: choose 1 of 3 cards from other characters to store in the [gold]Promise Ring[/gold].
PURE_LOVE_BEAM.title: Pure Love Beam
PURE_LOVE_BEAM.description:
Can only be played during [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold].
For each remaining turn of Full Manifestation, [gold]Rika[/gold] deals {RikaDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Then Full Manifestation ends.
AUTHENTIC_MUTUAL_LOVE.title: Domain Expansion: Authentic Mutual Love
AUTHENTIC_MUTUAL_LOVE.description:
Can only be played during [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold].
This combat, Full Manifestation no longer counts down.
Choose 1 of Rika's stored [gold]Techniques[/gold] to add to your [gold]hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
SLASH.title: Slash
BLADE_PARRY.title: Blade Parry
SOOTHE_RIKA.title: Soothe Rika
FLURRY_OF_CUTS.title: Flurry of Cuts
FLURRY_OF_CUTS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 3 times.
During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], 4 times instead.
RIKA_RAMPAGE.title: Rika's Rampage
RIKA_RAMPAGE.description: [gold]Rika[/gold] deals {RikaDamage:diff()} damage plus the HP she has lost.
REVERSE_CURSED_OUTPUT.title: Reverse Cursed Technique: Output
REVERSE_CURSED_OUTPUT.description:
[gold]Rika[/gold] heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
If she is in [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], it lasts 1 more turn.
UNTIL_DEATH.title: Until Death
UNTIL_DEATH.description: During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], at the start of each turn gain {UntilDeathPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
QUEEN_OF_CURSES.title: Queen of Curses
QUEEN_OF_CURSES.description: Whenever [gold]Rika[/gold] enters [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], it lasts 2 more turns and Rika gains 2 [gold]Strength[/gold].
TECHNIQUE_RELEASE.title: Technique Release
TECHNIQUE_RELEASE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times.
X is 1 plus the number of [gold]Techniques[/gold] stored in the [gold]Promise Ring[/gold].
